snapshot: WHO Western Pacific Region. Health policy is set centrally under the Healthy China initiative; the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030) started this year.

agenda.title: Healthy China under the 15th Five-Year Plan
agenda.text: At a national health meeting in Beijing in October 2026, President Xi called for decisive progress on the Healthy China initiative during the 2026-2030 plan period and for high-quality development of the health sector.

agenda.title: Population and birth support
agenda.text: The National Health Commission lists birth-support policies, childcare and paediatric services among the health sector's priorities for the plan period.

agenda.title: A larger role in global health
agenda.text: China nominated Li Song for WHO Director-General in October 2026; the World Health Assembly decides in May 2027. A Lancet commentary in November describes a wider Chinese bid to lead in global health.

nl.text: No separate bilateral health agreement found in public sources yet; the Dutch links below come from the NPHI Collaboration Map.
